g.title: X-V01
g.text: Dos cadenas: CAP-01 → BSV-01 → BP-04 ← ASV-02 ← AF-02 (AP-09) → LotHistory, y CAP-07 → BSV-05 → BP-03 → BO-03 ← QAResult ← ASV-03 → BP-07 (Despacho solo lee).
Relaciones: Assignment (●→) · Realization (- -▷) · Serving (→ abierta) · Access (··› escribe; ‹·· lee) · Triggering (→) · Flow (- -→) · Composition (◆) · Aggregation (◇) · Influence (- -› +)
